اطْلُبُوا مِنْهُ أَنْ يَنْقُلَ كَلَامَكُمْ: He said that …

units.title: Reported Speech
units.intro: We use reported speech to tell someone what another person said. The tense usually moves one step back.
items: The teacher said that the test was easy.
He said that the test was easy.
My friend told me that he was tired.
He told me that he was tired.
Mona asked me where I lived.
She asked me where I lived.

acts.title: Choose the reported sentence
acts.hint: Write the number of the correct answer in the box
rows: Ali said that he was hungry.
Ali said that I am hungry.
They said that we like football.
They said that they liked football.
Sara said that she could swim.
Sara said that she can swam.
He said that it is rain.
He said that it was raining.

acts.title: said or told?
acts.hint: Write the number of the correct answer in the box
rows: She ... me that she was busy.
My mother ... that dinner was ready.

units.title: Second Conditional
units.intro: We use If + past, … would + verb for imaginary or unlikely situations.
items: If I had a lot of money, I would build a school.
If I were a doctor, I would help sick children.
If I could fly, I would visit every country.

acts.title: Choose the right word
acts.hint: Write the number of the correct answer in the box
rows: If I ... a bird, I would fly.
If she had time, she ... read more.
If we ... a car, we would drive to Makkah.
What ... you do if you won a prize?

acts.title: Choose the best ending
acts.hint: Write the number of the correct answer in the box
rows: If I found a lost cat, ...
I would take care of it.

units.title: Relative Clauses
units.intro: We use whose for possession, when for time, and that for people or things.
items: This is the girl whose mother is a doctor.
He is the boy whose bike is red.
Friday is the day when we pray Jumu'ah.
Summer is the season when it is very hot.
This is the book that I like most.
She is the teacher that helped me.

acts.title: whose, when or that?
acts.hint: Write the number of the correct answer in the box
rows: That is the man ... son is my friend.
Ramadan is the month ... Muslims fast.
This is the pen ... I bought yesterday.
I know a boy ... father is a pilot.

acts.title: Join the sentences
acts.hint: Write the number of the correct answer in the box
rows: I met a girl. Her brother is in my class.
I met a girl whose brother is in my class.
I met a girl when brother is in my class.
I remember the day. I started school.
I remember the day whose I started school.
I remember the day when I started school.
This is the cake. My mother made it.
This is the cake that my mother made.
This is the cake whose my mother made.
He is the farmer. His cows give milk.
He is the farmer that cows give milk.
He is the farmer whose cows give milk.

units.title: Present Perfect Continuous
units.intro: We use have / has been + verb-ing for an action that started in the past and is still continuing.
items: I have been reading this book for two hours.
It has been raining since the morning.
How long have you been learning English?

acts.title: for or since?
acts.hint: Write the number of the correct answer in the box
rows: She has been waiting ... an hour.
They have been playing ... two hours.

acts.title: have been or has been?
acts.hint: Write the number of the correct answer in the box

units.title: Modals of Deduction
units.intro: We use must, might and can't to guess what is true from what we can see.
items: He has been working all day. He must be tired.
I am almost sure it is true.
She must be at home. Her car is here.
I'm not sure where Ali is. He might be at the library.
That can't be Omar. He is in Jeddah today.
I am almost sure it is not true.
It can't be cold. It's summer.

acts.title: must, might or can't?
acts.hint: Write the number of the correct answer in the box
rows: She is smiling. She ... be happy.
He just ate a big lunch. He ... be hungry.
I'm not sure. The keys ... be in the car.
They have played for hours. They ... be tired.

acts.title: Choose the best sentence
acts.hint: Write the number of the correct answer in the box
rows: The lights are off and nobody answers.
He can't be hungry. He's crying.
It can't be full of books.
It must be full of books.

units.title: Gerunds & Infinitives
units.intro: Some verbs are followed by verb-ing (enjoy, finish), and some by to + verb (want, decide).
items: I enjoy swimming in the sea.
He wants to be a pilot.
Have you finished reading the story?
I decided to learn a new language.
She decided to help her neighbour.

acts.title: The Young Volunteer
acts.html:
The Young Volunteer 🏥

Yasir has been volunteering at the hospital since last summer.
Last week, a little boy asked him why he worked there without money.
Yasir told him that helping people made him happy.
He said that if he were rich, he would build a hospital for poor children.
Yasir must be one of the kindest boys in his town.

acts.title: Answer
acts.hint: Write the number of the correct answer in the box
rows: Since when has he been volunteering?
What would he do if he were rich?
build a hospital for poor children
He gets a lot of money.

acts.title: The Science Fair
acts.html:
The Science Fair 🔬

Huda wants to be a scientist. She enjoys doing experiments.
Yesterday her teacher said that the science fair was next month.
Huda has been working on a project about saving water.
She might win a prize, but she says that learning is the real prize.

acts.title: Answer
acts.hint: Write the number of the correct answer in the box
rows: What does Huda want to be?
The science fair was next month.
What does Huda say is the real prize?
